plan.summary: Add Working Hours settings UI to Dashboard SettingsPage with GET/PUT API endpoints reading/writing tenant_registry.settings_json.working_hours. Tenant configures start/end times, off days, and timezone. WorkingHoursChecker already consumes this data — no Automation changes needed.
plan.interview_notes: UI: mevcut Ayarlar sayfasına section. Model: basit (tek start/end + days_off). Erişim: tenant kendi düzenler. Timezone: seçilebilir. Off-hours mesajı: bu UI'da yok (FlowBuilder'da kalır).

files_changed.change: Added Working Hours section with time/day/timezone controls

verification_questions.question: Does the GET endpoint return the working_hours object from settings_json with proper null handling when no working_hours configured?
Does the PUT endpoint use JSONB merge (jsonb_set or || operator) to update only the working_hours key without overwriting other settings_json keys like wapcrm?
Are both endpoints protected by ExtractTenantFromBearer JWT auth, ensuring tenant isolation (each tenant can only read/write their own working_hours)?
Does the PUT endpoint validate time format (HH:mm), days_off values (valid DayOfWeek strings), and timezone (valid IANA timezone) before writing to DB?

forbidden_areas: src/Invekto.Automation/ (WorkingHoursChecker already works, no changes needed)
arch/db/ (no schema changes, using existing settings_json JSONB column)
non_goals: Per-day different hours (kept simple: same start/end for all working days)
Off-hours message editing (remains in FlowBuilder FlowSettingsPanel)
intentional_exclusions: No new DB table (using existing tenant_registry.settings_json JSONB)
No Automation service changes (WorkingHoursChecker already reads this format)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All DB operations have NpgsqlException catches with SystemWarn logging. Frontend shows error state on API failure.
